stem: Voltmarkt has 1,000 app users: 800 heavy shoppers who spend €90 a month on average and 200 light shoppers who spend €40. It has 1,000 customers without the app: 200 heavy shoppers at €86 and 800 light shoppers at €38. What is the naive gap between the average monthly spend of app users and of customers without the app? Give it in euros with 2 decimals.
